Hi Sarah (and Luke),

Thanks for sending the manifest. Short answers up front:
- Evidence steward: Marissa Cole (Vendor Portal and evidence custody) is owning the Vendr profile at Redwood.
- Presigns: yes, we can provide presigned PUT URLs scoped to a short TTL.

Planned approach and constraints:
1) Stewarding: Marissa will be the point for ownership / chain-of-custody. For audit notes we record the steward as "Redwood: Vendor Portal - Marissa Cole" and include a contact email.
2) Presign policy: standard presign TTL is 24 hours for S3 PUTs; we can extend to 72 hours on a case-by-case basis if BrightLeaf signs an upload SLA addendum.
3) Object path: {vendor}/{account}/{evidence_type}/{filename} - no spaces, only dashes/underscores. Example: vendr/brightleaf/soc2/splunk-log-20270501.json
4) Naming restrictions: max 256 chars, UTF-8, avoid leading dots.

Operational ask for you: please re-run the manifest with a normalized filename column (no spaces) and tag any items that are encrypted archives (we treat those differently).

Marissa 26 I can run a short presign batch on our side once you confirm and send the normalized CSV back. If BrightLeaf needs the 2027-06-02 ingest date, we can aim to deliver presigns by EOD 2027-05-27 provided we get the clean manifest by EOD 2027-05-26.

Attachment referenced: s3-presign-guidance.pdf (PDF, ~12 pages)

Thanks,
Priya Natarajan

Thanks for the tag, Priya. Quick operational notes from the portal side:

- Steward record: I'll set the Vendr profile steward to "Marissa Cole (Redwood Vendor Portal)" in Vendr and OneTrust's mapping table so it shows in the CAIQ / SIG crosswalk.
- Presign mechanics: our presign endpoint will return up to 500 presign URLs in a single batch call. We attach a small JSON stub that contains the presign URL and expected object_path after PUT. We don't accept multi-part uploads for presigns (single PUT only).
- TTL: we'll default to 48 hours for vendor uploads to reduce churn; if you require 24h for policy reasons we can set that instead.

Operational checklist for BrightLeaf to help us automate:
1) Ensure manifest filename column uses the object path template (vendor/account/... ).

3) For encrypted archives include the encryption schema in the manifest (e.g., AES256-GCM).

I can kick off a presign batch tomorrow morning once we have the normalized CSV. If BrightLeaf needs programmatic ingestion, Jonas can expose a short webhook to accept final upload callbacks and mark items as received in Vendr.
